messages.en:
{07 15 00}It's ON, {ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Go time! At long last, the
day has arrived! 
{07 16 00}What day? {01 00 00 05 00}What DAY?{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 15 00}The day of bug-challenge
revenge and redemption!
{07 00 00}Well, {01 00 00 05 00}I don't care if you
know what I'm talking
about, so THERE!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 06 00}I just wanna see who's
faster at catching
{04 1a 00}!
{07 14 00}So, {01 00 00 05 00}the first one to catch
{04 1a 00} is
the best catcher EVER!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}See ON käes, {ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Aeg tegutseda! Lõpuks ometi on
päev saabunud! 
{07 16 00}Mis päev? {01 00 00 05 00}Mis PÄEV?{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 15 00}Putukaduelli kättemaksu
ja lunastuse päev!
{07 00 00}Noh, {01 00 00 05 00}mul ükskõik, kas sa
tead, millest ma
räägin, nii et VÕTA!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 06 00}Ma tahan lihtsalt näha, kes
on kiirem püüdma
{04 1a 00}!
{07 14 00}Nii et {01 00 00 05 00}esimene, kes püüab
{04 1a 00}, on
parim püüdja ÜLDSE!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey hey, {ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
How you doing? {01 00 00 05 00}You feeling
fit? {01 00 00 05 00}You stretched?
{07 16 00}Me, I'm so pumped up, I can
barely keep these muscles
in check, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}They're hungry!{01 00 00 05 00} They demand
satisfaction! {01 00 00 05 00}I gotta put
this energy to good use.
{07 0b 00}How about we race to catch
{04 1a 00}?{01 00 00 05 00}
C'mon, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei hei, {ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Kuidas läheb? {01 00 00 05 00}Kas oled
vormis? {01 00 00 05 00}Oled venitanud?
{07 16 00}Olen nii üles pumbatud, et
vaevu suudan neid lihaseid
ohjata, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Nad on näljased!{01 00 00 05 00} Nõuavad
rahuldust! {01 00 00 05 00}Ma pean selle
energia kasutusse panema.
{07 0b 00}Kuidas oleks, kui võistleme
{04 1a 00} püüdmises?{01 00 00 05 00}
Ole nüüd, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
